purpose: Define the machine-readable inventory CYNIC uses to map external dependencies across local organs, crates, packages and observed third-party agent frameworks.
contract_rules: Dependency coverage is source-backed: every dependency record must point to the manifest that declared it.
Unknown or unsupported manifest formats are reported as coverage gaps, not silently ignored.
Dependency inventory is observation and contract evidence; it must not decide provider policy by itself.
Runtime installation state is separate from declared dependency state.
Generated lockfile contents may be counted as evidence but must not replace manifest-level intent.
